summary: A person who lost a race is appointed to the seat when the winner moves away.
realLife: A woman who filed in 1975 and lost by seventeen votes to a write-in candidate was later appointed, eight to one, to his seat when he moved.
sources: Sturgis Historical Society, Bumpy Road to Victory, a recollection of the 1975 city commission race: https://www.sturgismuseum.org/?p=1170
inGame: `event:took-office` after `event:election-result` as the loser. `needs:` appointment to a vacancy as a path to office.

turns.writesBack: the line names who and the vote

turns.turn: The seat is filled by a special election.
